expr: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('[data-schedule-scroll]'); if(!s) return null; const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); const d = devicePixelRatio; return { cssRect: {top:Math.round(r.top), left:Math.round(r.left), w:Math.round(r.width), h:Math.round(r.height)}, dpr: d, deviceSwipe: {x: Math.round((r.left + r.width/2)*d), y1: Math.round((r.top + r.height*0.85)*d), y2: Math.round((r.top + r.height*0.15)*d)} } })()
